purpose: Define the input boundary Wave 3 may consume without promoting unresolved legacy semantics.

seat.web_adapter_decision: seat occupancy must be an explicit relation/state owned by Wave 3; do not infer it from chair image or ChairMainObjec presence

collision.web_adapter_decision: require an explicit collision provider; no legacy-equivalent geometry is supplied by Wave 2

walkable.web_adapter_decision: allow Wave 3 to inject a walk graph/grid as adapter data, labelled non-legacy until producer evidence is found

non_goals: derive seat state from pixels or alpha bounds
derive collision rectangles from furniture image dimensions
call adapter walkability a recovered legacy grid
